Container.Name: LMS
Container.Overview: Lightweight Music Server (LMS) is a self-hosted music streaming software: access your music collection from anywhere using a web interface. First run asks you to create the admin account, then one library per music folder.
Container.Description:
LMS is a self-hosted music streaming server written in C++ (low CPU and RAM), with a recommendation engine, multi-valued tags, artist relationships, MusicBrainz identifiers, ListenBrainz scrobbling, audio transcoding, ReplayGain and Subsonic/OpenSubsonic API support for the usual mobile clients.
### Volumes
- `/music` = the music shares to scan, **read-only**. Add one `<Config>` path per library and point the library path in the LMS web UI at the container path. - `/var/lms` = working data: `lms.db` (users, settings, libraries, scan state) plus the transcode cache. Back this up; it is the whole state of the server.
### Permissions
The image does not honour `PUID`/`PGID`, so the container runs as `--user 99:100` (`nobody:users`, the Unraid default) and `/var/lms` must be owned by it.
### First run
Open the WebUI and create the admin account. Then add a library (Settings → Libraries) with the container path of the music folder, and start the scan. The scan walks `lms.db`, so a large collection shows up progressively.
Container.Changes: First release. Bridge network on port 5082, appdata in /mnt/cache/appdata/lms, music read-only from /mnt/user/Music, runs as 99:100.
